That constant is defined in `src/interfaces/ecpg/include/sqlstate.h` of the PostgreSQL tree (ECPG's SQLSTATE header). It carries the SQL-standard class-07 "dynamic SQL error" code for "using clause does not match target specifications," and it has been unchanged across versions for many years:

```c
#define ECPG_SQLSTATE_USING_CLAUSE_DOES_NOT_MATCH_TARGETS	"07001"
```

(ECPG raises it from `error.c` for `ECPG_TOO_FEW_ARGUMENTS`, `ECPG_TOO_MANY_ARGUMENTS`, and `ECPG_TOO_FEW_VALUES`; the sibling constant `..._NOT_MATCH_PARAMETERS` is "07002".)

ANSWER: 07001
